entry: daemon-stored-session-views.mjs createStoredSessionViews().listSessions({ page }) over store-summary-reader.mjs listStoredSessionSummaryPage and readStoredSessionCatalogRow, on session records written to a data directory

exclusions.archived flag: the session tool's archived flag is the desktop sidebar's (`readSessionSidebarState`); the core keeps it in the store index from the record's archivedAt, so the recorder's sidebar flags the sessions whose record carries archivedAt
exclusions.index-only fields: the core's rows are the store index's summary, which also holds parentSessionId, presetName, effort, fast, modelParameters, permissionMode, schemaAllowedTools, taskType and compactCount; Node's JSON catalog rows (store-summary-catalog.mjs normalizedRow) do not carry them and the session tool never reads them from a list row, so the replay checks Node's row has none of them and drops them from the core's row before comparing the rest whole
exclusions.json listing: this Node's catalog DB is disabled (the bundled SQLite lacks the WAL-reset fix: `[session-catalog-db] disabled`, `catalog stays JSON`), and this process is not the desktop daemon's writer anyway, so Node answers from the JSON listing (store-summary-reader.mjs listJsonSummariesAsync)
exclusions.live overlay: the sessions with turns in flight are Node's runtimeState entries; the replay's overlay reports the recorded inFlightSessionActivity() as the runtime's facts
exclusions.page size: every walk asks an explicit page size, as the session tool does; the clamp of an absent or out-of-range limit is the session-list set
exclusions.records without messages: the sessions are header-only (messages: []): the store derives a row's preview and message count from the message log, which the replay's seeded store does not hold; the preview and count of a session with messages are not compared here
exclusions.storage stamp: a Node row carries `storageMtimeMs` and `storageSize`, the stat of the session's JSON file; the core's store has no such file (its rows hold 0), so the replay drops both from the two rows before comparing

product.tree: product tree loaded by the recorder

replay.compare: every page of every walk whole and in recorded order, every foreign cursor, every row by id, the archived flag of each row, the live overlay
replay.entry: StoreListing (mixdog-core/src/run_host/tool_pool/session_control.rs) over a SqliteStore seeded with the same sessions: page (rows whole, order, page size, nextCursor, malformed cursor) and row, with the live overlay of the recorded turns in flight

values: JSON of the listing as Node answered
